# Variables

Semantic variable names mapped to Klaviyo template tags (`variables/klaviyo.json`). Use `v('name')` in an email or `vars.get('name')` in a recipe. **Verified** means the tag was checked against Klaviyo's help center. Event variables (cart and order) depend on your ecommerce integration: copy them exactly from the event preview in your Klaviyo account.

| Name | Klaviyo tag | Verified | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer.first_name` | `{{ first_name\|default:'${fallback}' }}` | yes | The recipient's first name, with a fallback for people who have none. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `brand.name` | `{{ organization.name }}` | yes | Your organization name from Klaviyo's organization settings. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `brand.url` | `{{ organization.url }}` | yes | Your website URL from Klaviyo's organization settings. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `brand.address` | `{{ organization.full_address }}` | yes | Your postal address from Klaviyo's organization settings, required in commercial email. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `date.year` | `{% current_year %}` | yes | The current year, for copyright lines. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005257788) |
| `discount.expires` | `{% today '%Y-%m-%d' as today %}{{ today\|days_later:${days}\|format_date_string\|date:'${format}' }}` | yes | A date a number of days after the message is sent, for offer expiry. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005257788) |
| `discount.code` | `{% coupon_code '${coupon}' %}` | yes | A unique code from the Klaviyo coupon with this name. The coupon must exist in your account. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005084727) |
| `links.web_view` | `{% web_view_link %}` | yes | URL of the browser version of the email. Goes inside an href. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `links.unsubscribe` | `{% unsubscribe_link %}` | yes | Unsubscribe URL. Goes inside an href. The bare {% unsubscribe %} tag breaks inside an href. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `links.preferences` | `{% manage_preferences_link %}` | yes | Manage-preferences URL. Goes inside an href. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `email.preview_text` | `{% render_variable preview_text %}` | yes | The preview text set on the email screen in Klaviyo. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802648731) |
| `cart.items` | `event.extra.line_items` | yes | The list to repeat over in an abandoned-cart email (Started Checkout). A path, not a tag: it goes inside {% for item in ... %}. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408802445339) |
| `cart.item.title` | `{{ item.product.title }}` | yes | Product name inside the cart loop. Shopify shape, other platforms differ (some use item.title). Platform dependent. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002779071) |
| `cart.item.image` | `{{ item.product.images.0.src }}` | yes | Product image URL inside the cart loop. Shopify shape, other platforms differ (some use item.image_url). Platform dependent. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002779071) |
| `cart.item.price` | `{{ item.line_price }}` | yes | Line price inside the cart loop. Shopify shape, other platforms differ (some use item.variant_price). Platform dependent. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002779071) |
| `cart.item.quantity` | `{{ item.quantity }}` | yes | Quantity inside the cart loop. Platform dependent. [source](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002779071) |
| `cart.checkout_url` | `{{ event.extra.checkout_url }}` | **no** | Link back to the customer's checkout. Not confirmed in Klaviyo's help pages, copy it from your Started Checkout event preview. Platform dependent. |
